title: 第三章 寒舍第四章 都是祖传的
lines: 静！
全场寂静！
偌大的演武场，顷刻间鸦雀无声。
所有目光都聚焦在二长老身上，此刻的他，威风八面，霸气无双。
林昊惊呆了，很多人都惊呆了。
这是那个平日里游手好闲的林家二长老林振北？
一直以来，林昊都以为林双的玩世不恭是继承了他爹的优良传统，现在二长老给他来这么一出。
“不，这不可能。”
终于，脚下的王青松发出了嘶吼，他用尽全力挣扎，却无济于事，脸上那只大脚，像是一座大山，他就是蝼蚁，被踩在下面。
身体上的疼痛远不及内心的震撼。
他王青松是谁？
天宝城三大巨头之一，气海境三重天强者。
整个天宝城才有几个气海境。
一直以来，在王青松的内心，天宝城只有林家家主林振南，张家家主张山岳有资格和自己一较高下，林振北算哪根葱。
但今日，在此刻，他被林家二长老踩在脚下，毫无还击之力。
不远处，张山岳倒吸凉气，聪明如他，如何还不明白，林家隐藏了实力，而且一直在隐藏，根本不是他们惹得起的。
正如林振北说的那般，天宝城可以三足鼎立，也可以一家独大。
他们能在天宝城立足这些年，那是林家给他们脸了，平日相争，也从未真正计较过。
念及此，张山岳不敢再有半点怠慢，他走上前，对着林振南抱拳：“林兄，今日之事，是张某鲁莽了，深表歉意，来日备上厚礼，登门道歉。”
言罢，张山岳带着张家一众，几乎是跑着离开了林家。
年轻一代最出名的纨绔，一拳打死了王恒。
游手好闲的二长老一巴掌扇的王青松毫无还击之力。
细思极恐。
这一家子，没一个正常人。
惹不起。
王家也有聪明人，如何看不清楚形势。
王家一个长老连忙走了出来，又是赔礼，又是道歉，发誓以后要以林家马首是瞻。
“滚吧。”
二长老大发慈悲，挪走了脚。
王青松还想说什么，却被王家长老捂住了嘴，让王家人抬着王恒的尸体，然后一溜烟的跑了。
一场争端，就这样结束了。
黄良还愣在那里，有些发蒙。
这和自己预想的完全不一样，是两个极端。
事实是，张王两家也是受了黄良的蛊惑，不然不会来这么一出。
“黄公子，林家已经备好了寒舍，黄公子路途劳顿，歇息一天，明日让阿昊随你一起前往太玄宗。”
二长老走到黄良面前，笑着说道，一脸的和善，跟刚才的威猛霸气完全就是两个人。
黄良甩了甩有些发胀的脑袋，这才从发蒙的状态反应过来。
他现在不好说什么，也没有了之前的盛气凌人。
林家怕是没有自己想的那么简单，他现在看谁都像隐藏高手，看谁都不好惹，他有一种直觉，自己太玄宗弟子的名头，在这里都唬不住人。
关键，他们真敢杀人啊。
不远处，林阳和林双相互对望一眼，极有默契的咧嘴一笑。
“爹，黄公子的住所，我们兄弟亲自来安排。”
林双站了出来。
“嗯，不可怠慢。”
content_en:
quiet!
The whole place was silent!
The huge martial arts arena fell silent for an instant.
All eyes were focused on the second elder. At this moment, he was majestic and domineering.
Lin Hao was stunned, and many people were stunned.
Is this Lin Zhenbei, the second elder of the Lin family who usually idles around?
Lin Hao had always thought that Lin Shuang's cynicism was inherited from his father's fine tradition, and now the second elder was doing this for him.
"No, that's impossible."
Finally, Wang Qingsong screamed at his feet. He struggled with all his strength, but to no avail. The big foot on his face was like a mountain, and he was an ant being stepped on underneath.
The physical pain is far less than the inner shock.
Who is Wang Qingsong?
One of the three giants in Tianbao City, a strong man at the third level of Qi Sea Realm.
There are only a few Qi Sea realms in the entire Tianbao City.
For a long time, in Wang Qingsong's heart, there was only Lin Zhennan, the head of the Lin family, in Tianbao City. The Zhang family claimed that Shanyue was qualified to compete with him, and Lin Zhenbei was not the least of them.
But today, at this moment, he was stepped on by the second elder of the Lin family, without the ability to fight back.
Not far away, Zhang Shanyue took a breath of cold air. As smart as he was, why didn't he understand that the Lin family had hidden their strength and had been hiding it for a long time? They couldn't afford to offend him at all.
As Lin Zhenbei said, Tianbao City can stand on three pillars, or it can be a single family.
The fact that they have been able to establish themselves in Tianbao City all these years is because the Lin family has given them face, and they have never really cared about their daily quarrels.
Thinking of this, Zhang Shanyue did not dare to be negligent in the slightest. He stepped forward and clasped his fists at Lin Zhennan: "Brother Lin, what happened today was because Zhang was reckless. I apologize deeply. I will prepare a generous gift and come to apologize in the future."
After saying that, Zhang Shanyue led the Zhang family and left the Lin family almost running.
The most famous playboy of the younger generation killed Wang Heng with one punch.
The idle second elder slapped Wang Qingsong, who had no power to fight back.
It's scary to think about it.
There is no normal person in this family.
Not to be offended.
There are also smart people in the Wang family, but they can't see the situation clearly.
An elder of the Wang family came out quickly, apologized and apologized, and vowed to follow the Lin family's lead in the future.
"Go away."
The second elder showed mercy and removed his feet.
Wang Qingsong wanted to say something else, but the Wang family elders covered his mouth and asked the Wang family to carry Wang Heng's body, and then ran away quickly.
A dispute ended like this.
Huang Liang was still there, a little dazed.
This is completely different from what I expected. They are two extremes.
The fact is that the Zhang and Wang families were also bewitched by Huang Liang, otherwise they would not have acted like this.
"Young Master Huang, the Lin family has prepared a humble abode. Young Master Huang is tired from the journey. He needs to rest for a day. Tomorrow, let Ahao go to Taixuan Sect with you."
The second elder walked up to Huang Liang and said with a smile, his face was kind, and he was completely different from the powerful and domineering person just now.
"Ah...Okay, okay."
Huang Liang shook his somewhat swollen head and finally recovered from his dazed state.
He couldn't say anything now, and he was no longer as domineering as before.
The Lin family is probably not as simple as he thought. He now sees everyone as a master of concealment, and no one is easy to mess with. He has an intuition that his reputation as a Taixuan Sect disciple cannot intimidate anyone here.
The key is, they really dare to kill people.
Not far away, Lin Yang and Lin Shuang looked at each other and grinned in unison.
"Dad, our brothers will personally arrange the residence of Mr. Huang."
Lin Shuang stood up.
"Well, don't neglect it."
title_en: Chapter 3: The humble abode Chapter 4: It’s all passed down from ancestors
